standard_prerequisites.name: Tensor products commute with directed colimits
standard_prerequisites.use: Moves the chosen preimages of the generators down to a single stage of the colimit.

core_obligations: Choose finitely many generators x_1, ..., x_m of C_0 over B_0 and, using surjectivity after base change, preimages b_j in the base-changed algebra (proof lines 47778-47780).
Since the tensor product commutes with the directed colimit, the finitely many b_j come from a single stage i, and after increasing i their images hit the generators (proof lines 47780-47783).
Conclude that at that stage the base-changed map is surjective (proof lines 47783-47784).
proof_roadmap: Lift the finitely many generators across the base-changed map (proof lines 47777-47780).
Descend the finite lifting data to one stage of the colimit (proof lines 47780-47785).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that if a base-changed map of algebras is surjective and the source algebra is of finite type over the base, then the base-changed map is already surjective at some single stage of the colimit (statement lines 47763-47775). The proof does not argue with the union description of the colimit: it chooses finitely many generators, lifts them across the surjection, and uses that the tensor product commutes with the directed colimit to move those finitely many preimages down to one stage, increasing the stage so that they hit the generators (proof lines 47777-47785). Finiteness of the generating set is exactly what makes the descent possible, and the author writes the whole argument out. H2.
